boundary_semantics: Descriptive interpretation boundaries only; levels are not an ordinal target-quality scale.
disclaimer: MMP11 is an illustrative LUAD worked example. This synthesis organizes frozen evidence and dependencies; it is not a target score, ranking, therapeutic validation, clinical-efficacy claim, or recommendation.

levels.boundary: Expression association does not establish causality.
levels.maximum_supported_interpretation: MMP11 has a strong tumour-normal expression association in the project TCGA-LUAD analysis.

levels.boundary: Same-dataset robustness is not independent replication.
levels.maximum_supported_interpretation: The expression direction is concordant across six prespecified model variants.

levels.boundary: Published TCGA shares project lineage; external observations do not establish causality.
levels.maximum_supported_interpretation: Additional transcriptomic and tissue observations exist in external datasets and cohorts.

levels.boundary: Preclinical model effects do not establish patient efficacy or safety.
levels.maximum_supported_interpretation: Cell perturbation and xenograft experiments report phenotypic effects.

levels.boundary: The observations share publication/reagent lineage and do not validate a clinical intervention.
levels.maximum_supported_interpretation: An anti-MMP11 antibody produced effects in bounded preclinical models.

levels.boundary: A bounded registry search cannot prove global absence.
levels.maximum_supported_interpretation: No clinical validation is established by the frozen evidence package.

levels.boundary: Target selection, benefit, and safety require evidence beyond this synthesis.
